text:
eli: Heads-up: support keeps asking about preview vs apply semantics. Can we define the contract and minimal telemetry?

marta: Yes. Console preview shows a diff and simulation but no traceable id today. Support wants an auditable handle.

dyson: We should avoid preview emitting production metrics. Proposal: preview = read-only dry-run. Emit audit event + sampled telemetry only.

laura: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/preview -> { preview_id, diff, route_simulation, warnings }. preview_id links to audit logs.

ankur: Sampling: default 1% for previews. If preview touches sensitive keys (auth/quotas/kms) escalate to 100% logging. Tag previews with preview.sensitive=true.

marta: We'll mark sensitive fields in schema and server will bump sampling.

dyson: Add preflight mode: X-Config-Mode: preflight runs simulator synchronously (5s timeout) and will fail apply with 409 + details if constraints break. No production metric side-effects.

eli: Console UX: display "PREVIEW (not applied)" with preview_id and "Promote to canary" that preserves cohort and delta.

ankur: For dashboards: include a "pending changes" timeline: previews (read-only), preflights (pass/fail), applies. Telemetry should include preview_id/preflight_id tags.

marta: Edge-case: preview suggests moving QPS onto tiny pool. Preflight should check capacity against conservative headroom and return remediation steps if violated.

dyson: We have capacity signals; will add a lightweight guard in preflight.

eli: Action items: laura - API shape + headers; dyson/ankur - audit events + sampled telemetry + sensitive escalation + preflight capacity guard; marta - RFC and dashboard mock; ops-bot - remind deploy window constraints.

ops-bot: Reminder: next config deploy window Tue 02:00 UTC. Preflights must complete before window to be included.
